_comment: Registry of every e2e spec. verify.mjs reads it to deploy the right version(s) and check each spec. kind: 'regression' = red on brokenVersion, green on fixedVersion; 'open' = still red on brokenVersion, no fix yet (fixedVersion null); 'smoke' = green on `version` ('latest' resolves to the newest release). The reproduction array documents the manual steps the spec automates.

1363.title: Deleting a component inside an Horizontal layout also deletes the layout itself
1363.rootCause: The editor's delete (delElementIndex / closeOptions) removed the whole container instead of the selected child. Fix 1f58b05dd (plus follow-up fdabd9bd1) resolves the actually-selected child (getSelectedChildEditorItem / parentRef) and removes only it, leaving the layout and its other children. The layout-child UI was later refactored: on the fixed line each child has its own editor with a dedicated Supprimer; on the old buggy line the child is deleted from its config panel whose trash was wrongly bound to the parent.
reproduction: Log in and create a blank form; open it in the editor.
Add a Horizontal layout (palette tile 'Disposition horizontale').
Drag a Text input and a Description from the palette into the layout (real drag-and-drop; layouts only accept children by drag, not double-click).
Delete one of the two nested children (open the child's editor and click Supprimer, or on the old UI select the child and use its trash) and confirm.
On beta151 the entire Horizontal layout (and both children) is removed; the fix removes only the selected child and keeps the layout plus the other child.

1383.title: Renaming a page shows 'name already exists' when the field is left empty
1383.rootCause: The page-name validation raised the nameAlreadyexits message for any rejected value, including an empty one. Fix 269e0386e special-cases an empty/whitespace value to raise the dedicated emptyField message instead. The only observable change is the toast text (the Close button is not disabled), so the test asserts on the validation toast message.
reproduction: Log in and create a blank form (it already has one page named 'Page 1').
Open the form in the editor; accept the GDPR notice if shown.
Open the page settings (via the page buttons block or the Pages panel pencil) on the General section.
Clear the 'Nom de la page' field and commit (blur).
Observe the validation toast: beta158 shows 'Ce nom existe déjà...' (nameAlreadyexits) instead of the empty-field message 'Ce champ ne peut être vide' (emptyField).

1392.title: Clicking the Page buttons configuration redirects to General instead of Navigation
1392.rootCause: The click handler on the page navigation buttons block left page.local.currentPageSettingsPanel on 'general'; fix 542344019 (fix(actionsButtons)) sets it to 'navigation'. The active page-settings section is reflected by the app-settings-btn-active class on the General/Navigation toggles.
reproduction: Log in and create a blank form (it already has one page with the navigation buttons block).
Open the form in the editor; accept the GDPR notice if shown.
Click the page buttons block (the bottom bar holding the Submit/next/prev buttons).
Observe that the page settings open on the General section instead of Navigation (the General toggle is active).

1394.title: Source palette should offer a collapse all option
1394.rootCause: The Source palette only stored per-section expansion state and had no global action to collapse every expanded section. The fix added a list-collapse button plus shared local collapse/onClickCollapse state so one click can close all visible sections without breaking later manual toggles.
reproduction: Log in and create a blank form.
Add a Description component and open its configuration panel.
Observe the Source palette next to the rich text editor: several sections are expanded.
Click the Source palette collapse-all button.
All visible Source palette sections collapse.
Click one section header twice; it expands and collapses normally after the global action.

1399.title: Viewer expressions using api.* resolve in JavaScript defaults and Source Palette drops
1399.rootCause: viewerPage computeVariable shadowed the viewer API with page.api || {}, so api.user.* expressions evaluated against an empty object even though window["api"] was initialized. Fix 68e69971 falls back to window["api"].
reproduction: Log in and create a blank form through Studio.
Add a Text input and set its default value to JavaScript, keeping the generated async wrapper and returning api.user.email.
Add a second Text input and, in text mode, drag the User/email Source Palette entry into the default value editor.
Add a Description component and drag the same User/email Source Palette entry into TinyMCE.
Open the viewer: on beta204 the api.user.email defaults and description do not resolve; on the fixed version all three places render the test user's email.

1412.title: Map height breaks after opening Data & Interactions
1412.rootCause: The Data & Interactions editor stored config.minHeight without the px unit, producing invalid CSS that collapsed the map to ~44px, in both the editor canvas and the rendered viewer.
reproduction: Log in and open a form that contains a Map component.
Open the map's Configuration -> Données & Interactions tab.
Set the Height field to a value (e.g. 600) and close the panel.
Observe the map in the editor canvas: it collapses to ~44px instead of 600px.
Click Aperçu to open the viewer: the rendered map is collapsed there too.

1412-reopened.title: Map collapses when the height is cleared after being set
1412-reopened.rootCause: Side effect of the first #1412 fix: the viewer appends "px" to the value, so an empty (cleared) height becomes the invalid CSS "px" instead of falling back to the ~400px default.
reproduction: Log in and open a form that contains a Map component.
Open the map's Configuration -> Données & Interactions tab.
Set the Height field to a value (e.g. 550) and close the panel.
Reopen the same tab, clear the Height field (empty value) and close the panel.
Observe the map in the editor: it collapses to ~44px instead of returning to the ~400px default.
Click Aperçu to open the viewer: the rendered map is collapsed there too.

1413.title: Description breaks when a grid palette path contains a quoted column name
1413.rootCause: viewerPage generated JavaScript literals from grid path segments without escaping quotes or backslashes, so a column name like Owner's name produced invalid JavaScript.
reproduction: Log in and create a blank form.
Add a Table component and configure it from the Baserow source C8oForms E2E -> Regression Fixtures -> Issue 1413 Quote DisplayValue.
Set the table's returned value to Ligne sélectionnée.
Add a Description component, drag the table from the palette into the editor, expand the quoted Owner's name column and choose the value leaf exposed by the palette.
Click Aperçu, select the row containing Alice's quoted owner, and observe that beta214 logs SyntaxError: missing ) after argument list instead of rendering cleanly.

1419.title: Checkbox equality visibility value is edited as chips and disappears after reopening
1419.grep: checkbox equality visibility value uses the text editor
1419.rootCause: Open bug. Observed behavior: selecting a single Checkbox component as the left side of a Visibility equality condition renders the right side as a tag-input/chip editor. The chip is visible in the editor, but the saved visibleIf condition still has an empty val2.arr, so reopening the editor loses the value.
reproduction: Create a form with a Checkbox component whose technical id is checkbox1 and whose single value is Oui.
Add a Description component whose technical id is desc1.
Open desc1 configuration, go to Visibility, choose condition-based visibility and add a condition.
Set the left field to checkbox1 and the operator to equals.
Observe that the right value editor is a tag-input/chip editor even though it should be the text/TinyMCE editor used by Select visibility.
Enter the value Oui in the chip editor.
Return to Home from the editor, then reopen the same application in edit mode from the home card.
Reopen desc1 Visibility and observe that the value Oui is no longer restored.

1419-runtime.title: Visibility operators should resolve literal, JavaScript, and dropped input-text values in the viewer
1419-runtime.grep: visibility operators resolve literal, JavaScript, and dropped input-text values
1419-runtime.rootCause: Open bug family. The viewer must normalize simple and multi-valued condition operands consistently, including JavaScript-mode values and Source Palette input-text tokens saved inside tag-input values. Broken behavior leaves some dynamic values as raw HTML/token strings or compares multi-values incorrectly, so visibility conditions evaluate incorrectly.
reproduction: Create a form containing text inputs initialized by JavaScript defaults, one checkbox with Alpha and Beta selected, and target fields of multiple component types.
Add Visibility conditions covering equals, different, greater, greaterequals, minus, minusequals, contains, not_contains, is_filled, is_empty, among_following, and out_following.
Use literal right-hand values, JavaScript-mode right-hand values, and Source Palette input-text tokens wrapped in the HTML payload produced by drag/drop.
Open the viewer and verify each expected-visible target renders.
Verify each expected-hidden target is not visible, including hidden targets for description, text, checkbox, select, radio, slider, and datetime components.

1421.title: Anonymous legacy form without config should still open
1421.rootCause: Open bug. The anonymous viewer calls form.config.oneRespByPerson while loading a form, but some legacy anonymous published documents can lack the config object entirely. The fixture is accepted only when the config property itself is absent, not merely when config.oneRespByPerson is missing. On beta233 this throws or falls back to insufficient permissions before the legacy anonymous form can render cleanly.
reproduction: Seed the four CouchDB documents from tests/fixtures/forms/1421 into c8oforms_fs: draft, published, anonymous published, and PWA document.
Verify that published_1670939636590_anonymous is named 'test ano 1421' and has no top-level config property at all.
Open the anonymous viewer URL for published_1670939636590 with the anonymous key from the PWA targetId/anonymousKey.
Observe that beta233 does not tolerate the missing config and the anonymous form fails to load cleanly, showing insufficient permissions or logging an error around oneRespByPerson.

journey-login.title: Authoring: log in
reproduction: Open the app.
Click the landing Log in to reveal the form, enter the test user in both fields and submit.
The authenticated home (selector) loads.

journey-create-form.title: Authoring: create a blank form

On the home/selector, click the blank-form card.
Enter a name and save; the editor opens on a blank form.

journey-add-component.title: Authoring: add a Map component

In the editor, double-click the Map tile in the palette.
The map is added to the page and renders.

journey-rename-technical-id.title: Authoring: rename a component technical identifier
reproduction: Create a blank form and add a Map (see the other journeys).
Open the map's configuration.
Change the technical identifier; it persists on blur.
